commentary: With market breadth deteriorating to a weak score of 39 despite index-level resilience at 23,270, Stan Weinstein's market-timing rules mandate defensive posture and strict capital preservation. While DII liquidity creates localized bounces, William O'Neil's CANSLIM principles warn that three out of four stocks track the broader market tide. When breadth breaks down under institutional distribution, breakout failure rates multiply. Mark Minervini's progressive exposure rule dictates keeping position sizes small, raising cash, and strictly limiting new entries to pristine Stage 2 setups displaying asymmetric reward-to-risk. Until breadth re-expands above key moving averages, defensive stops and aggressive risk containment remain paramount.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Trading above rising 21-day EMA, 50-day SMA, and 200-day SMA. Price is within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot accompanied by 2× average volume, showing constructive price compaction.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Fundamentals fail CANSLIM criteria. Q1 FY27 net sales collapsed 56% YoY and PAT fell 25% YoY to ₹1.02 crore. ROE remains poor at 2.75% with low interest coverage.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Fails below entry trigger 101.39; exit strictly at stop loss 92.26 on base breakdown.

ACE.technical: Classic Stage 2 continuation above key moving averages. Forming a solid double bottom base with neckline pressure, supported by expanding 1.16× volume and a decisive bullish engulfing daily bar.
ACE.fundamental: Robust industrial demand lifted Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue 20.5% YoY and net profit 22.3% YoY. Excellent operational efficiency with ROCE exceeding 31% and negligible balance sheet leverage.
ACE.risk: Pattern breaks below double-bottom swing support; enforce stop immediately at 1111.18.

AEGISLOG.technical: Superb leadership structure displaying a High Tight Flag pattern above all key moving averages. Breakout momentum is supported by 2.15× volume expansion, pristine relative strength, and healthy RSI at 55.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Phenomenal CANSLIM profile. Q1 FY27 consolidated profit surged 212% YoY and revenue climbed 37% on record LPG volumes. Strong balance sheet with ROCE near 20% and expanding cash reserves.
AEGISLOG.risk: Reversal back into flag consolidation invalidates setup; cut losses strictly at 1376.44.

AMDIND.technical: Clearing an intermediate base within a Stage 2 trend, positioning above all major EMAs and SMAs. The breakout attempt is backed by heavy 3.16× volume expansion and positive MACD confirmation.
AMDIND.fundamental: Explosive turnaround with Q1 FY27 net profit surging over 500% YoY to ₹9.12 crore and sales up 40%. However, low historical ROCE (1.43%) warrants scrutiny regarding earnings sustainability.
AMDIND.risk: Thesis invalidates if price undercuts double bottom low; maintain hard stop at 64.10.

ANANDRATHI.technical: Constructive double bottom consolidation above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. Volume expanded 1.41× on pivot approach, maintaining exceptional relative strength near all-time highs.
ANANDRATHI.fundamental: High-quality compounding fundamentals with AUM surpassing ₹1 lakh crore. Q1 FY27 PAT grew 23.5% YoY with 34% net margins, zero debt, and outstanding ROE above 40%.
ANANDRATHI.risk: Neckline rejection violates base symmetry; execute disciplined Minervini stop at 2168.14.

ARROWGREEN.technical: High-velocity SEPA breakout printing new 52-week highs on explosive 9.82× 20-day average volume. Structural alignment is robust across all key moving averages with steep relative-strength outperformance.
ARROWGREEN.fundamental: Dramatic operational turnaround in Q1 FY27, with revenue jumping 111% YoY to ₹87.8 crore and standalone PAT leaping 184%. Return ratios are superior with ROE near 40% and negligible debt.
ARROWGREEN.risk: Breakout failure below the breakout bar low terminates trade; enforce stop at 800.89.
